nome: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II
sintesi: Study ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels burning in low-velocity forced flows in microgravita.
risultato_chiave: BASS-II results contribute to the combustion computational models used in the design of fire detection and suppression systems.
fonte_note: [PSI-25 Approach]: wind tunnel installed in Microgravity Science Glovebox... airflow speeds up to 40 cm/s | [NTRS 20150019858, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20150019858]: "Oxygen concentrations in the MSG working volume were varied during the testing from ambient ISS oxygen levels (~ 21% O2) ... down to ~ 14% O2 for very near-limit flames." | [NTRS 20210011385 BASS-II Summary Report, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20210011385]: "O2 concentrations in the MSG working volume were varied during the testing from ambient ISS O2 levels (~21 percent O2) down to ~14 percent O2 for very near limit flames." | DOI e piattaforma dalla scheda PSI.
note: Flusso min vuoto: la fonte cita solo il massimo di 40 cm/s. DOI da riverificare sul sito PSI. O2 14-21% preso dal paper NTRS 20150019858 (DA VERIFICARE che coincida con BASS-II). Pressione non indicata come condizione di prova (solo 1 atm nel calcolo). Lo stesso paper cita flusso max ~55 cm/s senza restrittori e ~35 cm/s con due restrittori; la scheda PSI dice fino a 40 cm/s: valori diversi, tenuto quello della scheda. | Flusso: la scheda PSI dice fino a 40 cm/s; il Summary Report NTRS 20210011385 scrive 'With no restrictors, the maximum flow velocity was ~55 cm/s, and with two restrictors this was reduced to ~35 cm/s'. Tenuto 40 della scheda. Pressione non indicata nel report: vuota.

sintesi: Determine how rapidly a large scale fire grows in low-gravity and investigate the low-g flammability limits.
risultato_chiave: Saffire-1 experiments were performed on the Cygnus resupply vehicle after it deberthed from the ISS.
fonte_note: [PSI-98 Approach]: Saffire-I was conducted at an air flow velocity of 20 cm/s | [NTRS 20170000230, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20170000230]: "The oxygen concentration in the Cygnus vehicle will be nearly 21% by volume"; [NTRS 20170001636, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20170001636]: "Saffire-I will be conducted at an air flow velocity of 20 cm/s". | DOI e piattaforma dalla scheda PSI. Valori dalla tabella della scheda PSI (atm→psia x14.696).
note: Flusso costante a 20 cm/s (min=max). DOI da riverificare sul sito PSI. | Nome ufficiale PSI: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-I (era '...Fire Safety...'). | O2 21% = valore nominale PREVISTO nei paper pre-volo ('nearly 21%'), non misurato. Pressione non indicata: vuota. I paper NTRS 20220002714 (Saffire-IV) e 20240007488 (Saffire-VI) riguardano altre missioni: non usati.

note: Flusso e pressione non esplicitati nella descrizione: lasciati vuoti. nome: Structure and Liftoff in Combustion Experiments
sintesi: Examine flame stabilization, liftoff, and blowout limits in laminar jet flames in microgravity.
fonte_note: [PSI-106 Approach]: SLICE investigation on propane jet flames | [NTRS 20150011070, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20150011070]: "five coflow velocities (peak coflow velocity vO,max approximately equals to 18, 39, 48, 54, and 71 cm/s) under both microgravity and normal gravity"; [NTRS 20140017780]: "nominal air coflow of 18 cm/s". | DOI e piattaforma dalla scheda PSI.
note: Progetto SLICE non e' tra i valori ammessi: messo 'altro'. Valori numerici assenti. DOI da riverificare. | Flusso = velocita' di picco del coflusso d'aria (18-71 cm/s). I paper trattano fiamme di metano (CH4 70-100%); il campo combustibili (propano) viene dalla scheda PSI: da verificare. Ossigeno e pressione non indicati: vuoti.
